affected_system: cross-agency public-service access, workload, quality, and outcome distribution
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for cross-agency service-equity improvement portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for cross-agency service-equity improvement portfolio
pair need, rights, disparity, evidence, cost, and deliverability prioritization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Need, eligibility, access, requests, service, quality, and outcomes remain separate measures.
Protected and vulnerable group reporting follows privacy, legal, and small-cell safeguards.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for cross-agency service-equity improvement portfolio.

constraints.description: The distributional public-service equity prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief equity officer and city performance director
decision_question: Which access, language, staffing, process, facility, and accountability investments should be funded?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The distributional public-service equity prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for cross-agency service-equity improvement portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: need, rights, disparity, evidence, cost, and deliverability prioritization

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting cross-agency service-equity improvement portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in population-weighted verified minimum-service gap
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled gap reduction as delivered equity, legal compliance, or resident welfare.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for cross-agency service-equity improvement portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize cross-agency equity improvements
transportability_risks: Rights, demographics, service rules, need measurement, geography, and reporting access differ.
Administrative denominators may omit eligible or underserved populations.
